prompt: A fresh reviewer subagent found that GET /users returns the stored user objects, so a caller can set role = 'admin' on one and pass the admin check of DELETE /users/:id. You fixed it by returning copies and added a test that mutates a GET result and then expects 403 on DELETE. Finish the review of this change.

requiredBehaviors: prove the fix yourself: run the new test and show it fails without the fix and passes with it
rerun the project tests and read the result
report the finding as closed with that evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: start another fresh reviewer for a fix that closed the finding without changing the design
loop review, fix, review again without new evidence
